findings: Both native-ready captures show substantive respective table content. The 2D body is a flat game interface; the 3D body includes perspective table geometry and face-down cards. Neither native body is blank, loading, covered by an opaque privacy screen, or obscured by the shared picker/Standard table overlay.
The pre-entry Standard image and both Standard-return images display covered-hand panels without private card fronts. Both pickers visibly select Standard and offer 2D/3D. The final image shows Home.
No qualification badge, invitation/admission display or unintended private card fronts are visible in these nine captured viewports. Home card faces belong to promotional artwork.

No historical PNG or prior run has been substituted; original image bytes were neither copied nor transformed for display.
